functions.name: when
functions.spark_sql:
WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id,
        id % 4 = 1 AS flag,
        CAST(CASE WHEN id % 4 = 1 THEN '7' ELSE 'bad' END AS BIGINT) AS value
    FROM bench WHERE id < 24
)
SELECT id, CASE WHEN flag THEN value END AS result FROM operands
